findings.text: The company was incorporated on 12 August 2024 and is recorded as active, with a status detail of active-proposal-to-strike-off.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.

The confirmation statement is overdue; the next one is due on 25 August 2026, and the last was made up to 11 August 2025.
There is one current officer, a director, PERSON 249, appointed on 13 August 2024.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 251, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of the shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 294 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement.
